title: OddsFlow Settled Predictions
description: One settled bet on a finished match, with the context it was entered on. One row per model × source: the same decision taken by two engines, or placed at two brokers, appears more than once — `model_key` and `source` identify which is which. Generated from the V9 per-bet log; rows up to 2026-08-24 from the retired V8 engine are archived separately under datasets/settled-predictions-v8-archive/ and carry an extra `pressure_signal` column that V9 does not record.

final_score.description: Full-time score, "home-away". Empty when the fixture carried no final score.

market.description: AH = Asian Handicap, OU = Over/Under, 1X2 = match result

line.description: Handicap or goals line at entry (e.g. 0.75, 2.5). Empty for 1X2.

entry_odds.description: The odds OddsFlow recorded when entering — our own trade record, not a resold bookmaker feed.

entry_minute.description: Match clock when the signal fired. 0 = before kick-off.

score_at_entry.description: Scoreline when the bet was placed, "home-away".

model_key.description: Which engine produced the entry, e.g. oddsflow_handicap_sniper.

source.description: Where the bet was recorded: APIFOOTBALL, HGA or NOVA88.

stake.description: Stake units allocated by the model

profit_loss.description: Settled profit or loss in stake units; negative is a loss.
